law.course: The article this course rests on; hours and refresher are the company's programme.
law.fitness: Only the doctor's judgement is kept (fit, with limits, unfit), never clinical data; health data is protected and each view recorded.
law.instruction: Hands-on instruction at the workstation, signed by the person.
law.language: Training is valid only when the person understood the language it was given in.
law.machines: Work equipment that needs specific knowledge is used only by people trained on it.
law.needs: Who needs which course follows from the role sheet (risk assessment) and the machines a person is authorised on.
law.roleSheet: The risks of the role and what they ask: PPE, training, health surveillance.
law.training: The employer trains every worker on the risks of their job, in a language they understand; the register keeps who did what and when.

need.classOwner: A machine type asks courses of the whole group, from the day each authorisation starts.
need.nobody: Nobody holds this role or authorisation now.

need.roleOwnerLater: The courses of a role are edited in its role sheet (the risk assessment page of Plant, coming).

record.peopleHint: One record per person, in one go

refusal.ARCHIVED: This course is archived: restore it first.

refusal.CLASS_RETIRED: This machine type is no longer in use.
refusal.CODE_TAKEN: This code is in the catalogue already.
refusal.CORRECTED_ALREADY: This record was corrected already: correct the newest one.
refusal.COURSE_NOT_AVAILABLE: The course is archived or of another company: pick an active course.
refusal.COURSE_NOT_GROUP_WIDE: A machine type asks only courses of the whole group.
refusal.COURSE_REQUIRED: A role sheet or a machine type asks this course: remove it there first.
refusal.ENTRY_SIGNED: This entry is signed already: it is only voided now.
refusal.HAS_RECORDS: Records came from this session: it is closed, not cancelled.
refusal.IMPACT_CHANGED: Something changed meanwhile: review what this changes again.
refusal.INSTRUCTOR_IS_PERSON: The instructor is not the person instructed.
refusal.IN_FUTURE: The day is later than today.

refusal.MACHINE_NOT_OF_CLASS: The machine is not of the type named.
refusal.NOTHING_CHANGES: The correction says what the record says.

refusal.NOT_OF_SESSION: This attendance is not of this session.

refusal.TRAINER_NOT_AVAILABLE: The trainer does not work for this company.
